name: quadrature
source:
! Integrate x**2 over [0,1]; verify the result rather than only printing it.
! Module callbacks avoid executable-stack trampolines for internal procedures.
module audit_functions
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use quadrature_module, only: integration_class_1d
   implicit none
contains
   function square(me, x) result(y)
      class(integration_class_1d), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x
      real(wp) :: y
      y = x*x
   end function square
end module audit_functions

program demo
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use quadrature_module, only: integration_class_1d
   use audit_functions, only: square
   implicit none
   type(integration_class_1d) :: integral
   real(wp) :: answer, estimate
   integer :: status
   call integral%initialize(fx=square, xl=0.0_wp, xu=1.0_wp, tolx=1.0e-10_wp, methodx=8)
   call integral%integrate(answer, status, estimate)
   if (.not. ieee_is_finite(answer)) error stop 'nonfinite integral'
   if (abs(answer - 1.0_wp/3.0_wp) > 1.0e-9_wp) error stop 'incorrect integral'
   print '(a,f15.12,a,i0)', 'PASS quadrature integral=', answer, ' status=', status
end program demo

name: roots
source:
! Solve x**2 - 2 = 0 with Brent's method.
! Module callbacks avoid executable-stack trampolines for internal procedures.
module audit_functions
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use root_module, only: root_solver
   implicit none
contains
   function equation(me, x) result(y)
      class(root_solver), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x
      real(wp) :: y
      y = x*x - 2.0_wp
   end function equation
end module audit_functions

program demo
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use root_module, only: brent_solver
   use audit_functions, only: equation
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp) :: x, residual
   integer :: status
   type(brent_solver) :: solver
   call solver%initialize(equation, rtol=1.0e-12_wp)
   call solver%solve(0.0_wp, 2.0_wp, x, residual, status)
   if (.not. ieee_is_finite(x)) error stop 'nonfinite root'
   if (status /= 0 .or. abs(x - sqrt(2.0_wp)) > 1.0e-9_wp) error stop 'incorrect root'
   print '(a,f15.12)', 'PASS roots sqrt(2)=', x
end program demo

name: pchip
source:
! Interpolate linear data and verify an interior value.
program demo
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use pchip_module, only: dpchim, dpchfe
   implicit none
   real(wp) :: x(3), f(1,3), d(1,3), query(1), answer(1)
   integer :: status
   logical :: skip
   x = [0.0_wp, 1.0_wp, 2.0_wp]
   f(1,:) = 2*x + 1
   call dpchim(3, x, f, d, 1, status)
   if (status < 0) error stop 'derivative calculation failed'
   skip = .false.
   query = 0.5_wp
   call dpchfe(3, x, f, d, 1, skip, 1, query, answer, status)
   if (.not. ieee_is_finite(answer(1))) error stop 'nonfinite interpolation'
   if (status < 0 .or. abs(answer(1) - 2.0_wp) > 1.0e-12_wp) error stop 'incorrect interpolation'
   print '(a,f8.4)', 'PASS pchip value=', answer(1)
end program demo

name: toml
source:
! Parse a small TOML document and retrieve its integer value.
program demo
   use tomlf, only: toml_table, toml_error, toml_parse, get_value
   implicit none
   type(toml_table), allocatable :: table
   type(toml_error), allocatable :: error
   integer :: answer, status
   call toml_parse(table, 'answer = 42', error=error)
   if (allocated(error)) error stop 'TOML parsing failed'
   call get_value(table, 'answer', answer, stat=status)
   if (status /= 0 .or. answer /= 42) error stop 'incorrect TOML value'
   print '(a,i0)', 'PASS toml answer=', answer
end program demo

name: datetime
source:
! Advance across a leap-year day and check the resulting calendar date.
program demo
   use datetime_module
   implicit none
   type(datetime) :: start, finish
   start = datetime(2024, 2, 28)
   finish = start + timedelta(days=2)
   if (finish%getYear() /= 2024 .or. finish%getMonth() /= 3 .or. finish%getDay() /= 1) &
      error stop 'incorrect calendar arithmetic'
   print '(a,a)', 'PASS datetime date=', finish%isoformat()
end program demo
